GERMAN — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Extensive reading Scanning, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Extensive reading Scanning.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Extensive reading Scanning.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Extensive reading Scanning.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive reading Scanning.

2. When practising Intensive reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Intensive reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Intensive reading.

3. When practising Listening for details Conversational skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for details Conversational skills.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Listening for details Conversational skills.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for details Conversational skills.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Listening for details Conversational skills.

4. When practising Listening comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Listening comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening comprehension.

5. When practising Intensive Reading Skimming, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive Reading Skimming.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Intensive Reading Skimming.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Intensive Reading Skimming.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive Reading Skimming.

6. When practising Reading for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Reading for comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading for comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for comprehension.

7. When practising Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.

8. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Thank you
   B. Please
   C. Good day / hello
   D. Good night

9. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Schule
   B. Wasser
   C. Buch
   D. Haus

10. When practising Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.

11. When practising Reading comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Reading comprehension.

12. When practising Public speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Public speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Public speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Public speaking.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Public speaking.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Descriptors Adjectives , Comparative, Superlative -Vorlieben Ordinal numbers Dem and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for gist and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Directions and locations ● Articles in the Nominative, Accusative and Dative cas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Conjunctions and Verbs ● Conjunctive adverbs dann, danach.... ● Conjunctions ● M and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Language Structures 1. Dative verbs (gut/schlecht - gehen, weh tun, empfehlen, g and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Language Structures ● Verbs with separable and inseparable prefixes ● Prepositio and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Language Structures ● Reported Speech ● Demonstrative articles, dieser, diese, d and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Listening comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Listening for details Conversational skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
